seoTitle: Colorado School Calendar 2026-2027: Start Dates, Breaks & District Calendars
seoDescription: Find Colorado school calendars for 2026-2027, including Denver Public Schools and Jeffco start dates, breaks, no-class days, official PDFs, and downloads.
heroDescription: Colorado school calendar dates, breaks, PDFs, and calendar downloads · Sourced from official district websites
quickAnswer: Colorado public school calendars are set locally by district. Featured Colorado examples include Denver Public Schools and Jeffco Public Schools, with district-specific details such as separate K-12 and ECE first days, student contact-day counts, conference/no-class dates, staff-learning days, potential snow make-up days, translated family calendar PDFs, and last-day early release.
about:
Colorado school calendars are approved locally by district, so first days, last days, breaks, staff-learning days, conference days, weather make-up rules, and school-level events can differ across the Denver metro area and the rest of the state.

Featured Colorado examples include Denver Public Schools and Jeffco Public Schools. DPS family/student calendars distinguish K-12 and ECE first days, list 174.5 student contact or instructional days, mark conference/no-class dates, identify vacation or staff-learning no-class days, and mark the last day as an early-release day. Jeffco family calendars list 171 student contact days, teacher workday counts, teacher staff development days, potential snow make-up days, translated family calendar PDFs, and last-day dismissal notices for district-run schools when applicable.

Families should use the districtwide calendar as the starting point, then check their school for bell schedules, transportation notices, testing, athletics, performances, graduation details, charter school schedules, and campus-specific events.

faqs.q: Are Colorado school calendars the same statewide?
faqs.a: No. Colorado school calendars are set locally by district, so start dates, breaks, staff-learning days, and last days can differ.

faqs.q: When does Denver Public Schools start?
faqs.a: Use the Denver Public Schools calendar page on MySchoolDates for the reviewed DPS first day. DPS may mark separate first days for K-12 and ECE students.

faqs.q: When does Jeffco Public Schools start?
faqs.a: Use the Jeffco Public Schools calendar page on MySchoolDates for the reviewed Jeffco first day, breaks, potential snow make-up days, translated calendar PDFs, and official source links.

faqs.q: Can I download a Colorado school calendar PDF?
faqs.a: District pages on MySchoolDates include official PDF links when available. Choose the district page first because Colorado does not publish one statewide school calendar PDF.

faqs.q: Can I add a Colorado school calendar to Google Calendar?
faqs.a: Yes. District pages on MySchoolDates include calendar download options when available, including ICS files that can be imported into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook.
